## How Medipyxis validates ICD-10 diagnosis codes

Source: `modules/billing/diagnosis-code-validation` — https://help.medipyxis.com/modules/billing/diagnosis-code-validation/

Live claims: 20 · confirmed 13 · PR evidence only 0 · advice/external 0 · not confirmed 7 · removed 0

### qbl-05 — ADVICE: not a product claim

> Status meanings: Needs Coding / Eligibility Needed = not ready to submit yet; Ready = reviewed and ready to submit; In Progress / Hold / Flag Clinical = working it / paused / sent back to the clinician; Billed = submitted to the payer; Paid / Partial Pay = payment posted; Denied = work it in Denial Management; Appealed / Corrected = appeal filed / corrected and resubmitted; Patient Responsibility / Write-Off / Void = closed outcomes.

Claim Status is a manual working label; the product attaches no behaviour to these meanings.
